<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a template that converts two aldehyde groups into an alkene (McMurry coupling). This matches the target, which can be obtained from two equivalents of 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde, a cheap, commercially available chemical. I will search the template catalog for a reaction that breaks an aldehyde and forms an alkene.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehyde"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
